Name: Sebastian After Dark - A Yan-Kuudere Dialogue and Event Expansion Pack
Author: loshionbottle
Description:
[url=https://ibb.co/6rGLgt3][img]https://i.ibb.co/9cBSs4F/overview.png[/img]
[/url]This mod adds around 450 lines of dialogue for Sebastian, plus overhauls all of his vanilla events while adding in 8 new events!
This is a smut-free pack!

[i][size=5][b][color=#ea9999]POTENTIAL TRIGGER WARNINGS[/color][/b][/size]
[/i]There are no smut events in this pack! However, this is supposed to be creepy & you may or may not like what's offered here. Please view the following at your own distretion.

[u][b]OVERALL
[/b][/u]The figure's NPC is used in a few events. Its presence is supposed to be unsettling. There are [b]smoking and non smoking versions of events[/b].

[u][b]SPECIFICALLY[/b][/u]
[list=1]
[*]The smoking version of the 1 heart event includes Sebastian smoking into your face with the non-smoking version of the 1 heart event includes Sebastian fondling a butterfly knife (get it ig)[/*]
[*]TW the 3 (Pt 1) heart includes Sam (fr tho: It's implied the farmer drinks and throws up, two men fight over you, and there's a brief stalker entrance (view this at fullscreen for the best experience frfr))[/*]
[*]The 3 (Pt 2) Heart is a HEAVY stalker mention; someone will break in if you don't lock your doors. It's implied you're asleep, but NOTHING HAPPENS TO YOUR FARMER. Just some cameras get fixed is all[/*]
[*]The smoking version of the 5 heart includes a shotgun kiss with the non-smoking version of the 5 heart includes sharing a lollipop[/*]
[*]For the 6 heart vanilla rewrite: refer to the DND Decision Branches photo[/*]
[*]The 6 (Pt 2) heart is an implied wet dream. The dream version of you touches him. A lot. Also ur a bit dominating here ;)[/*]
[*]For the 7 heart: refer to the CCTV Decision Branches photo[/*]
[*]For the 9 heart: you get pinned to a couch and potentially kissed depending on the route you take; you do have the option to deny[/*]
[/list]
[i][size=5][color=#ea9999][b]DECISION BRANCHES
[/b][/color][/size][/i]The rewritten vanilla 6 heart and new 7 heart events are heavily decision based. The following shows different routes you're able to take. 
[b]TWs are included in these photos. Please view at your own discretion.[/b]
[url=https://ibb.co/bMps279J][/url]
[center][url=https://ibb.co/bMps279J][img]https://i.postimg.cc/C1TGGVSn/dndbranchesupdated.png[/img]
[/url][url=https://ibb.co/67kWffZy][img]https://i.postimg.cc/66LdsSft/cctvbranchesupdated.png[/img][/url][/center]

[url=https://ibb.co/6Z7yTqB][img]https://i.ibb.co/n0NwYKC/faq.png[/img][/url]
[color=#ea9999][i][b]What portrait mod are you using in the mod photos? [/b][/i][/color]
I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16838]Rin's Portraits[/url]!

[i][b][color=#ea9999]Is this compatible with...?[/color][/b][/i]
For most dialogue mods it's an iffy thing. If you're placing in a dialogue mod for Sam, then yeah this one'll work fine. On the other hand, If you're ﻿placing in a mod for Sebastian, like some other Sebastian dialogue mods, then no. HOWEVER, in the config option there are options to turn off the dialogue/events if you prefer someone else's!

[u][b]AN IMPORTANT NOTE ABOUT COMPATIBILITY
[/b][/u]This modpack edits Sebastian's room & some room strings. This clashes with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE's[/url] room changes. I've set things up to where SVE [b]will[/b] override these edits to avoid errors in your game, so if you're not getting his room changes, check the other mods you have installed.

Also, having both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4668]Platonic Relationships[/url] and After Dark packs might fuck up the 10 heart event a lil, so be wary of using both. 1.1.2 Might've fixed the game breaking issues but Platonic Relationships still might override my 10 heart.

If you're someone who wants to use a mod for polyamory: these packs aren't made with them in mind, but they should work fine together.

[color=#ea9999][b][i]Can I translate to...?﻿[/i]
[/b][/color]Yes! I give you my full permission to translate to whatever language you're wanting! Just be sure to note me as the original author, please!


[url=https://ibb.co/92ppqBy][img]https://i.ibb.co/nfwwD4Q/requirements.png[/img]
[/url]As well as [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], you need [b]Shadows After Dark & Sam After Dark[/b]!


[url=https://ibb.co/4JMC6Lz][img]https://i.ibb.co/HXYRWy6/configmenu.png[/img][/url]
[b][size=3][color=#e06666]PLAYER CONFIGURATION[/color][/size]
[/b]
[b]Player Pronouns: 
[/b][color=#ea9999][b]CAUTION - These are DIFFERENT compared to my other packs.
[/b]If you use She/Her pronouns, PAY ATTENTION to where you're putting things. I did not make an error here. [/color]
  ﻿There are 4 slots for you to input your pronouns:
﻿  ﻿﻿- Player Pronouns 1: [i]Would typically be something similar to "Them", "Her", "Him".
[/i]  ﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 2: [i]Would typically be something similar to "They're", "She's", "He's".
              - [/i]Player Pronouns 3:[i] [i]Would typically be something similar to "They", "She", "He".
[/i]  ﻿  ﻿- [/i]Player Pronouns 4:[i] [i]Would typically be something similar to "Their", "Her", "His".[/i]
[/i][b]Pet Name: 
[/b]  ﻿Sets a desired name he refers to you as. I've been told users use things like "Angel", "Sunshine", "Babe", etc.
[b]Descriptive Word:
[/b]  ﻿Would typically be "Pretty", "Cute", "Handsome", etc.
[b]Good...:
[/b]  ﻿Erm, it's called a PRAISE KINK, tyvm. But, this is typically "Boy", "Girl", [s]"Slut"[/s]


[b][size=3][color=#e06666]ADDICTION/SCHEDULE CONFIGURATION[/color][/size][/b]
[b][color=#ea9999]CAUTION - These are DIFFERENT compared to my other packs.[/color][/b]
[b]
Addiction Status:[/b]
You're able to choose from the following, which are self-explanatory: 
﻿  ﻿- Non-Smoker
﻿  ﻿- Smoker - Cigarettes
﻿  ﻿- Smoker - Joints
﻿  ﻿- Quits Smoking - Cigarettes
﻿  ﻿- Quits Smoking - Joints
Depending on your selection, his in game schedule might be affected. You're able to turn this off by toggling [b]"Schedule Edits".[/b]


[b][size=3][color=#e06666]EVENTS/DIALOGUE CONFIGURATION[/color][/size]
[/b]
You are able to turn off events in general by toggling[b] "After Dark Events".[/b] 
You are able to turn off dialogue by toggling all four options given:[b] "Generic, Marriage, Gift, Festival".[/b]
﻿You're also able to choose which dialogue shows up, given said options. 


[url=https://ibb.co/qW2rtsC][img]https://i.ibb.co/YyVLzkX/event-triggers.png[/img][/url]
The triggers & console commands for the rewritten vanilla events are the same as base game! 
[i][b]
[size=3]THE NEW EVENT TRIGGERS ARE AS FOLLOWS:[/size][/b][/i]

[b][color=#f4f4f4]1 Heart Event:[/color][/b] Enter the mountain from 8pm to 12am
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands: 
[code][color=#e06666][b]debug ebi ADSebIntro[/b][/color][/code][/*]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4][b]
3 Heart Event, Pt 1:[/b] [/color]You must have seen Sebastian's vanilla 2 heart event and Sam After Dark's Bathhouse scene first. Enter the Saloon on a sunny day from 8pm to 12am.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code][color=#e06666][b]debug ebi ADSebJealous[/b][/color][/code][/*]
[/list][b][color=#f4f4f4]
3 Heart Event, Pt 2:[/color][/b] You must have not seen Sam's Post Seb Fight event. You must've seen the previous event first. Enter the bus stop from 8pm to 12am. For story's sake, it's best to view this one immediately after the previous event. 
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code][color=#e06666][b]debug ebi ADStalkableFarmer[/b][/color][/code][/*]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4][b]
5 Heart Event:[/b] [/color]You must've seen Sebastian's vanilla 4 heart first. Enter the mountain from 8pm to 12am.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code][color=#e06666][b]debug ebi ADShotgunKiss[/b][/color][/code][/*]
[/list][b][color=#f4f4f4]
**NEW** 6 Heart Event:[/color][/b] You must've seen the vanilla 6 heart event first. Just plain enter Robin/Seb's house.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code][color=#e06666][b]debug ebi ADSebWetDream[/b][/color][/code][/*]
[/list][b][color=#f4f4f4]
7 Heart Event:[/color][/b] You must've seen the previous event first. Enter Sebastian's room.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code][color=#e06666][b]debug ebi ADCameraStalker[/b][/color][/code][/*]
[/list][b][color=#f4f4f4]
7 Heart Event, Pt 2:[/color][/b] This is conditional on getting Ending 2 of the previous event. Enter Sebastian's room when he's there. See the decision branch photo on how to get it.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code][color=#e06666][b]debug ebi ADCameraStalkerEnd2[/b][/color][/code][/*]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4][b]
9 Heart Event: [/b]Y[/color]ou must've gotten a letter from Sebastian saying to meet him in his room. To get the letter, you must have 9 hearts and have seen the vanilla 8 heart event. To trigger the actual event after recieving the letter, enter his room from 6pm to 12am.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code][color=#e06666][b]debug ebi ADSebCouchFuckin[/b][/color][/code][/*]
[/list]
